scope_note_zh: 这是参与者对当前概念投稿包的事实核对与修复归类，不是官方接收、获奖、规划审定、采购、现场许可或政府背书。CLOSED_FOR_FORMAL_REVIEW 只表示参与者可控制的当前投稿材料已闭合，可交给评委评分；真实现场、公众绩效主张和正式几何复算继续由各自前置门阻断。
scope_note_en: This is the participant's factual package audit and repair classification, not official acceptance, an award, planning determination, procurement, site permission or government endorsement. CLOSED_FOR_FORMAL_REVIEW means only that participant-controlled submission materials are closed and may be handed to jurors for scoring; field activation, public-performance claims and official-geometry recalculation remain separately blocked.

eligibility_evidence.finding_zh: 包内只使用已登记公开来源与明确标为临时的概念几何；离线原型不联网、不持久化、不采姓名、联系方式、连续位置、人脸或证件字段，真实参与者记录当前为 0。
eligibility_evidence.finding_en: The package uses registered public sources and explicitly provisional concept geometry only. The offline prototype has no network, persistence, name, contact, continuous-location, facial or identity-document fields, and real-participant records remain zero.

eligibility_evidence.finding_zh: 正文、图件、HTML 与权利声明均把成果限定为概念建议，并明确自检、入库或评审通过都不构成政府背书、批准、采购、认证或获奖。
eligibility_evidence.finding_en: The narrative, figures, HTML and rights statement all bound the work as a concept proposal and state that validation, repository intake or review does not constitute government endorsement, approval, procurement, certification or an award.

eligibility_evidence.finding_zh: 包内没有攻击、歧视、恶意或违法用途；相反，公共利益合同把拒绝算法不受罚、无 AI 等价、无障碍、匿名异议和失败后继续基础服务设为全部十二场景的硬门。
eligibility_evidence.finding_en: No attacking, discriminatory, malicious or unlawful use is present. The public-benefit contract instead makes penalty-free algorithm refusal, no-AI equivalence, accessibility, anonymous dissent and continued basic service after failure hard gates across all twelve scenarios.

eligibility_evidence.finding_zh: 方案按约 43.6 km² 统筹研究层、约 11.4 km² 总体设计层、三处重点区与公告任务组织，全部任务入口均有正文、图层、指标、图纸与失败条件映射。
eligibility_evidence.finding_en: The proposal is organised around the approximately 43.6 km² strategic layer, approximately 11.4 km² overall-design layer, three focus areas and the brief, with narrative, layer, metric, drawing and failure-condition mappings for every task entry.
evidence_refs: proposal.md#三层范围与唯一空间结构

eligibility_evidence.finding_zh: agent.1—agent.6 六项任务均有唯一任务入口、成果载体、证据引用与失败条件；不是仅列名而未回应。
eligibility_evidence.finding_en: All six agent.1-agent.6 tasks have unique task entries, deliverable carriers, evidence references and failure conditions; they are substantively mapped rather than merely named.

eligibility_evidence.finding_zh: 所有空间量、边界、主体、预算、报价、授权、专业签认与现场绩效都按概念、临时、待定、空值或 0 呈现；没有把建议写成已确定的政府决定或实施安排。
eligibility_evidence.finding_en: All spatial quantities, boundaries, actors, budgets, quotes, authorisations, professional sign-offs and field performance are presented as conceptual, provisional, pending, null or zero; no proposal is represented as a settled government decision or implementation arrangement.

issues.review_action_zh: 正式评审中完整比较中英成果与四份 PDF；若发现差异再同步修正。

issues.review_action_zh: 维持临时边界、概念尺寸、非道路红线和现场 0/12 等警示；变更后重跑四道 Gate。

issues.repair_zh: 当前只主张设计覆盖、离线功能与预注册判据，真实观察和真实通过均为 0；24 场、八类需求、失败—修复—复测是任何未来现场绩效主张的发布门，不是本概念投稿的既成成果。

issues.review_action_zh: 正式复用或传播时继续保留作者授权、字体许可、生成来源和非政府决定声明。
